correctedBytesWereTheAppliedBytes.conclusion: The migration bytes at 6e78632 were the corrected bytes, so the Aug 3 burst applied the corrected definition. supersessionStatus 'supersedes-before-first-application' remains accurate: the supersession did precede first application, and first application has now occurred.
correctedBytesWereTheAppliedBytes.limitation: This proves what the LOCAL tree held at 6e78632. It does not independently observe what the hosted project received. The link from local tree to hosted apply is the PARKED.md CL5(ii) log evidence, which carries that section's PARTIAL strength.

provenanceLimitations: PARKED.md is a SECONDARY repository summary. It is a record of rulings and witnessed findings written after the fact, not a primary artifact.
The PRIMARY artifacts — hosted Postgres logs, the dashboard captures, and the dispatch-thread terminal transcripts — are NOT checked into this repository and cannot be re-read from it.

The hosted organization is on the Supabase FREE plan with one-day log retention, and log_connections/log_disconnections are off. The Aug 3 2026 DDL-burst log window expired long before this record was written, so the primary evidence for the six Study migrations is permanently unrecoverable. It cannot be re-derived by any later session, authorized or not.
Nine of the ten migrations rest on version-ledger match and structural reconciliation rather than byte comparison. Only 20260801160000 carries a side-by-side content comparison.
The foundation-four membership disagrees with hosted-foundation-baseline-evidence.json as recorded above.

This file records that these migrations ARE in hosted history. It does NOT record that the hosted objects are byte-identical to the current repository files, and nothing here licenses skipping a future equivalence check.

consequenceForThisRepository.derivedAsOfNote: This consequence section — and only this section — was restated after the C2 operations contract was composed onto this reconciliation. The restatement is arithmetic on the current lineage, not new provenance: no hosted contact was made, no historical evidence above this section was reopened, re-derived, or weakened, and every claim about what is in hosted history still rests exactly on the record as originally written. The prior text named a single remaining executable migration and was accurate on the eleven-file lineage it was written against; the lineage grew to twelve files and that count had fallen behind. It was extended again the same day, to thirteen files, when the actor-bound session verification overload was appended — recorded here in the same derived section and under the same limits.
